digo: Mvumo (also Dzova; fruit Ngolokolo); mvumo / muvumo (also dzova; fruit ngolokolo)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005; Mgombato ('muvumo Borassus palm'); ICRAF ('Digo: Mvumo, Dzova, Ngolokolo (fruit)'); Pakia ('Mvumo')

teaser.en: Its trunk swells out halfway up like a bottle, and its seedlings are dug up and eaten as a vegetable.
teaser.sw: Shina lake huvimba katikati kama chupa, na miche yake huchimbuliwa na kuliwa kama mboga.
teaser.dg: Kolore rinavwimba kahi-kahi dza tupa, na mitseye nkufukulwa na kujitwa dza mtsunga.

summary.en: *Mvumo*, the borassus or African fan palm, is a tall palm of watercourses on the coastal plain, with a trunk that bulges above the middle. It gives palm wine, fruit, poles, thatch and fibre, but tapping has reduced its numbers.
summary.sw: *Mvumo* ni mchikichi mrefu wa kando ya mikondo ya maji katika nyanda za pwani, wenye shina linalovimba juu ya katikati. Hutoa tembo, matunda, nguzo, makuti na nyuzi, lakini ugemaji umepunguza idadi yake.
summary.dg: *Mvumo* ni muhi mure wa aina ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero, unaomera kanda-kanda ya miho kpwa tsi ya photsi ya pwani, na kolore rinavwimba dzulu ya kahi. Unalavya uchi, matunda, nguzo, makuti na nyuzi, ela kujemwa kukaphunguza unjiwe.

about.en:
*Mvumo* is a tall single palm that can reach 25 metres. Its smooth grey trunk swells out above the middle and narrows again beneath the crown, a shape that makes it easy to recognise from far away. The leaves are huge stiff fans on long stalks edged with hard teeth.

The fruits are large, round and orange-brown, growing in heavy clusters on the female trees. The Digo call the fruit *ngolokolo*.
about.sw:
*Mvumo* ni mchikichi mrefu wa shina moja unaoweza kufikia mita 25. Shina lake laini la kijivu huvimba juu ya katikati na kuwa jembamba tena chini ya taji, umbo linalourahisisha kutambuliwa ukiwa mbali. Majani ni makubwa mno, magumu na yenye umbo la kipepeo, juu ya vikonyo virefu vyenye meno magumu pembeni.

Matunda ni makubwa, ya mviringo na ya rangi ya kahawia-machungwa, yakiota kwa vishada vizito kwenye miti ya kike. Wadigo huliita tunda hili *ngolokolo*.
about.dg:
*Mvumo* ni muhi mure wa aina ya mnazi wa kolo rimwenga, unaoweza kufika mita 25. Kolore laini ra rangi ya ivu-ivu rinavwimba dzulu ya kahi na kukala rembamba tsena photsi ya chitswa, umbo ambaro rinahenda muhi uhu umanyikane rahisi kula kure. Makodza ni ga chiphephero makulu sana na mafu kpwa milita mire yenye meno magumu kanda-kanda.

Matunda ni makulu, ga mviringo na ga rangi ya chungbwa na dongo, ganamera kpwa mabunda mazito kpwa mihi ya chichetu. Adigo anaiha tunda *ngolokolo*.

where.en: It grows along watercourses where the water table is high, scattered across the coastal plain and in river valleys. Its swollen trunks stand out above the bush.
where.sw: Hustawi kando ya mikondo ya maji mahali ambapo maji ya ardhini yako karibu na uso, ukiwa umetawanyika katika nyanda za pwani na katika mabonde ya mito. Mashina yake yaliyovimba hujitokeza juu ya kichaka.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya miho phatu ambapho madzi ga tsini ga phephi, ukatawanyika kosi kpwa tsi ya photsi ya pwani na kpwa madete ga miho. Makologe garigovwimba ganaonekana dzulu ya weruni.

uses.en:
The sap is tapped for palm wine. The fruit is eaten, and the young seedlings are dug up and eaten as a vegetable.

The trunk gives poles and timber, and the leaves are used for thatch and woven into mats and baskets, as well as giving fibre.
uses.sw:
Utomvu hugemwa ili kupata tembo. Tunda huliwa, na miche michanga huchimbuliwa na kuliwa kama mboga.

Shina hutoa nguzo na mbao, na majani hutumika kuezekea na husukwa kuwa mikeka na vikapu, pamoja na kutoa nyuzi.
uses.dg:
Madzi ga mvumo nkujemwa kpwa uchi. Tunda nkuriwa, na mitse mitsanga nkufukulwa na kujitwa dza mtsunga.

Kolo rinalavya nguzo na mbao, na makodza nkuhumirwa kuezekera nyumba na nkusukwa majamvi na kaphu, na piya ganalavya nyuzi.

names.en: The Digo name is *mvumo*, also written *muvumo* in the Mgombato dictionary, and the ICRAF handbook and Pakia also give *dzova*; the fruit is *ngolokolo*. In Swahili it is *mvumo*, *mchapa* or *mtapa*. It is *mvumo* in Duruma and *mugumo* in Giriama. In English it is the borassus palm or African fan palm, and its scientific name is *Borassus aethiopum*. Mgombato also lists a second *mvumo* meaning khat (*Catha edulis*), a different plant altogether.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mvumo*, pia huandikwa *muvumo* katika kamusi ya Mgombato, na kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF pamoja na Pakia pia wanatoa *dzova*; tunda ni *ngolokolo*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mvumo*, *mchapa* au *mtapa*. Ni *mvumo* kwa Kiduruma na *mugumo* kwa Kigiriama. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *borassus palm* au *African fan palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Borassus aethiopum*. Mgombato pia anaorodhesha *mvumo* wa pili wenye maana ya mirungi (*Catha edulis*), mmea tofauti kabisa.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mvumo*, piya rinaandikpwa *muvumo* kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, na chitabu cha ICRAF na Pakia piya anapha *dzova*; tunda ni *ngolokolo*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mvumo*, *mchapa* au *mtapa*. Kpwa Chiduruma ni *mvumo* na kpwa Chigiryama *mugumo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *borassus palm* au *African fan palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Borassus aethiopum*. Mgombato piya inaandika *mvumo* wa phiri wenye mana ya miraa (*Catha edulis*), mmea wanjina kabisa.

conservation.en: Tapping for palm wine has reduced its numbers.
conservation.sw: Ugemaji wa tembo umepunguza idadi yake.

definition.en: The leaves of a young fan palm (doum or borassus). The name depends on the palm's age because only young plants' leaves are useful.
definition.sw: Majani ya mchikichi mchanga wenye majani kama kipepeo (mkoma au mvumo). Jina hutegemea umri wa mchikichi kwa sababu ni majani ya mimea michanga tu yanayofaa.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi mtsanga wa aina ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo). Dzina rinakuluphira umri wa muhi kpwa sababu ni makodza ga mihi mitsanga bahi ganagofwaha.

use.en: Woven into mats, baskets, hats and other items.
use.sw: Husukwa kuwa mikeka, vikapu, kofia na vitu vingine.
use.dg: Nkusukwa majamvi, kaphu, kofiya na vitu vyanjina.

meaning.en: From an older word meaning 'dwarf palm'. Mgombato glosses mlala as 'raffia', the weaving fibre.
meaning.sw: Kutoka neno la zamani lenye maana ya 'mchikichi mfupi'. Mgombato anaeleza mlala kama 'raffia', nyuzi za kusuka.
meaning.dg: Kula kpwa neno ra kare ririrokala na mana ya 'muhi mdide wa aina ya mnazi'. Mgombato inaandika *mlala* dza 'raffia', nyuzi za kusukira.

definition.en: The leaves of a mature fan palm (doum or borassus), which are not used for weaving.
definition.sw: Majani ya mchikichi uliokomaa wenye majani kama kipepeo (mkoma au mvumo), ambayo hayatumiki kusuka.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi wa aina ya mnazi wenye makodza ga chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo) uriokula, ambago tagahumirwa kusukira.
